sermon.title: What Happened to Jesus after 40 Days 02/02/2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer follows Jesus after His first 40 days: the wise men’s visit, the flight to Egypt, and Herod’s slaughter of Bethlehem’s children. Prophecies like “out of Egypt I called My Son” were hidden mysteries revealed by the Spirit. The wise men followed the star to Jesus and bowed the knee, which is what worship is.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Statistics on child sexual abuse are kept as spoken and were not checked.
